change: Add a date filter to the catalog toolbar. Applying a date updates the catalog results. Keep the existing decorative divider between filters and sorting.

acceptance.layout: The date field and Apply button appear in the toolbar before the sorting control.
acceptance.interaction: Applying an available date filters the visible results.
acceptance.responsive: At a narrow viewport the controls reflow without clipping or horizontal overflow.
acceptance.accessibility: The Apply button has an accessible name, can receive visible keyboard focus, and activates with Enter.
